correctness.rationale: Exact edge-increment coordinates identify parent composition with 1 plus a bounded lower-triangular block B=(U,0;L,N) on the spine and tooth increments. For bounded tooth lengths, N is uniformly nilpotent, so nonzero-pencil Fredholmness reduces by bounded invertible factors to the one-sided shift U. The explicit telescoping functional gives closed range of codimension one for 0<|lambda|<1; approximate boundary vectors give nonclosed range at |lambda|=1. Infinitely many tooth terminal coordinates give an infinite kernel at lambda=0. For unbounded tooth lengths, explicit supported vectors have norm one and residual |lambda|^m for 0<|lambda|<1 and 1/m for |lambda|=1; injectivity at nonzero lambda makes these nonclosed-range obstructions. All exterior parameters are invertible by the Neumann series. The precise estimates prove the infinite-dimensional claims; 1085 exact rational assertions are supplementary.

value.rationale: A natural complete classification of a canonical one-ended, uniformly bounded-degree tree family: every tree has the same single infinite end and ordinary spectral disk, yet uniformly bounded terminal-tooth depths produce an isolated essential spectral point at zero and a Fredholm index -1 throughout the punctured disk, while unbounded depths fill that essential hole. This quantifies a meaningful geometry/operator-theory boundary rather than recomputing a known table or an arbitrary special parameter.
